category: hosted metrics, logs, traces and profiles (observability platform)

free_tier.stated: Free plan at USD 0 with no credit card: all Grafana Cloud services with usage limits, including 10k active metric series, 50 GB of logs, 50 GB of traces and 50 GB of profiles ingested per month, 500 k6 virtual user hours per month, 3 active users and 14 days of retention; a new account starts with a 14-day trial and then moves to the free plan
free_tier.notes: Logs, traces and profiles are counted in GB ingested, metrics in active series and k6 tests in virtual user hours. Ingestion past a free limit is discarded rather than billed, according to a Grafana community forum answer.

per_object_cap.stated: 256kb per log line (max_line_size, not modifiable) and 5MB per trace (max_bytes_per_trace) by default

retention.stated: 14 days for metrics, logs, traces, profiles and k6 performance tests on the free plan

egress.terms: not stated: the pricing page prices ingestion and retention and names no charge for querying data back

interface_detail: Every Grafana instance exposes an HTTP API; the Grafana Cloud API (GCOM) manages stack resources; Tempo exposes an API for pushing and querying traces; Synthetic Monitoring has a REST API
tooling: the hosted Grafana UI, the Grafana HTTP API, the Grafana Cloud API, and the Tempo and Synthetic Monitoring APIs
chaining: A hosted log, metric and trace store for scripts on free compute: 50 GB of logs a month with 14 days of history, queried from the same hosted Grafana.

limits.value: 50 GB of logs, 50 GB of traces and 50 GB of profiles ingested per month
10k active metric series per month (a count of series, not bytes)
14 days for metrics, logs, traces, profiles and k6 tests
256kb per log line; 5MB per trace by default

limits_note: 3 active users per month and 500 k6 virtual user hours per month on the free plan.
binding_note: Ingestion past 10k active series or 50 GB of logs in a month is discarded until the month resets; metrics with many label values reach the series count first.

identity_cost.detail: No credit card required on the free plan; the sign-up page offers Google, GitHub, Microsoft or Amazon sign-in, or an account form. Account creation starts a 14-day trial, after which the account moves to the free plan; trial usage is never billed.

reliability_note: ingestion past a free limit is discarded for the rest of the month rather than billed (community forum answer)
